description: This file defines a React functional component 'MembershipsPage' that manages and displays membership plans, handles subscription actions, and displays member perks. It interacts with several external services to fetch data and perform actions related to memberships.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads plans, current membership, activity status, and perks, updating the component state accordingly.

methods.name: onSubscribe
methods.description: Handles subscribing to a plan given its ID, updates current membership status, and shows notification.

methods.name: onCancel
methods.description: Cancels the current membership and updates state, also shows a notification.
